metadata.source: User's HelloTracks account (live.hellotracks.com/zones) -- a private org tenant, not public GIS. Confirmed by the account owner: Tehsil Nishtar contains exactly these 14 UCs, no others.
metadata.method: Each UC's zone polygon was viewed individually on HelloTracks' real Mapbox/OSM basemap via screenshots the user provided. Positions here are a single representative point per UC, anchored to a recognizable place-name label visible within that UC's own screenshot and matched against this repo's already-georeferenced mouza coordinates where a clear name match exists (see mouzas_nishtar.geojson). This is NOT a traced polygon boundary -- without a pixel-picking tool, visually estimating vertex coordinates from a screenshot produced two independent scale checks that disagreed by ~13%, too imprecise to publish as a boundary shape.
metadata.caveat: Points only, not boundaries. 'moderate' confidence = anchored to a real matched place name; 'low'/'very low' = no name match or no pixel access at all, positioned by relative adjacency only. For real UC boundary polygons, the reliable path is exporting the zones' GeoJSON from HelloTracks itself (e.g. via its Network tab) rather than screenshot tracing.
